title: The Cutting EDG: April 5th, 2021
body:
## Tech

- Edgeware (EDG) is now listed at [cointostake](https://cointostake.com/) (POS list, staking statistics, live data, monitoring, POS staking calculator, staking rewards)
- Thom Ivy [opens a discussion on EDG citizen benefits](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1101-concept-edg-citizen-benefits) treating the chain's native token like a social token capable of forming partnerships, signaling identity and status, and granting access to products and services. 
- Raymond Zhong opens a discussion on [Layer Wallet: an edgeware mobile wallet that prioritizes usability, simplicity, and extensibility](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1093-layer-wallet-an-edgeware-mobile-wallet-that-prioritizes-usability-simplicity-and-extensibility)
- Chris Thomas opens a discussion on [a user-centric Asset Management platform for Edgeware](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1096-a-usercentric-asset-management-platform-for-edgeware) 


## Ecosystem Updates

**Commonwealth.im**
_The multi-chain governance and community interface._
The Commonwealth team has finished v1 for contracts on Commonwealth Protocol. This week and next, they’re testing + auditing the contracts. Design work is complete but not implemented yet and boilerplate structures for integration have been built. The landing page and mobile app are being worked on by an external agency. The landing page is expected to ship within the next two weeks.
 
**DTrade**
_DTrade is a platform for trading perpetuals and options on Edgeware._
No major updates this week, just building.
 
**Decent Partners**
_Decent is a 'metadao' that seeks to create crypto-native public media._
Decent [shared their recent progress in crafting their offer](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/831-decent-an-edgeware-ecosystem-project-update-150321) to Edgeware users in return for an upcoming treasury proposal to fund digital arts and media assets in the public's interest.
